title: HttpRequestReceptor
description: Identifies the receptor that receives HTTP requests. The endpoint pattern and accepted methods define the API contract surface. Source: RFC 9110 §4 — Identifiers in HTTP, §7.1 — Determining the Target Resource.

targetUri.description: URI template pattern identifying this receptor's endpoint address (e.g., '/api/users/{id}'). Defines WHERE this port listens. Source: RFC 6570 (URI Template, 2012); RFC 9110 §4.
